      How we build

      Apps should earn their place
      on your phone. Every time.

      01

      Focused

      Every app does one thing and does it well. We don't add features to justify updates. We ship when it's ready and maintain what we've shipped.

      02

      Fair pricing

      One-time purchases where possible. Subscriptions only when ongoing infrastructure genuinely requires it, and only at prices that feel reasonable.

      03

      No dark patterns

      No manufactured urgency, no hidden costs, no data selling. If you don't love it, the refund is easy to find.

      About

      Small team.
      Real products.

      Hatch Apps LLC is an independent app studio building useful, well-crafted tools for everyday situations. We're not chasing trends, we're solving problems we find genuinely interesting.

      Each product is designed to be self-sustaining, fairly priced, and built to last. We'd rather have a thousand users who love what we made than a million who barely remember downloading it.
